task.problem: TASK-249 / RUN-249-002 / REVIEW-249-001 is exactly published at 84739c2a13d9d89ef5379ecba7a9d4b83ed64771 and returns canonical planning to HUMAN_BRAIN_LIVE_PUBLIC_PDP_PILOT_AUTHORIZATION with zero fresh validation attempts. TASK-250 r1 correctly separated authorization from execution and bound one future Human-operated validation to the exact TASK-249 carrier source, but pre-execution audit found unresolved live-boundary risks. The V2 carrier writes its durable attempt marker before Playwright session acquisition, so an unreachable CDP endpoint or ambiguous borrowed-page state would consume the sole attempt after carrier entry. r1 also did not bind the preflight job root/browser state to the invocation, did not freeze all direct execution-critical ProductCandidateSnapshot/BrowserConfig/session-protocol files, did not require preservation and hashing of the external marker/result through post-attempt review, and did not explicitly distinguish operation SUCCESS from per-field validation success. Revision 2 closes those gaps without changing production code or widening live authority.
